Position: General Practitioner
Location:  Maddington, Perth WA
Salary: 170,000 - $250,000
Full-time: 38 hours per week

IMGs requiring supervision: Guaranteed salary plus super, including comprehensive Level 1 supervision. 
 Fully Registered/VR GPs: Excellent earning potential with a competitive percentage of billings (up to 65%) and an established patient base (plus superannuation where applicable).

About Us
Burslem Medical Centre is a well-established, accredited general practice located in Maddington, approximately 25 minutes from Perth CBD. We provide comprehensive, patient-centred healthcare to a diverse community and are supported by an experienced multidisciplinary team committed to delivering high-quality medical services.
Due to continued patient demand and practice growth, we are seeking an experienced and dedicated General Practitioner to join our busy and supportive team.

About the Role
The successful applicant will provide high-quality primary healthcare services to patients of all ages while working collaboratively with nurses, allied health professionals and administrative staff.

Key Responsibilities
•	Conduct patient consultations and comprehensive medical assessments. 
•	Diagnose, treat and manage acute and chronic illnesses. 
•	Develop and implement patient management and treatment plans. 
•	Prescribe medications and arrange appropriate investigations. 
•	Provide preventative healthcare, health education and disease management. 
•	Perform minor medical procedures where appropriate. 
•	Refer patients to specialists and allied health practitioners as required. 
•	Maintain accurate and timely clinical records. 
•	Participate in health promotion and quality improvement activities. 
•	Comply with AHPRA, RACGP and Medicare requirements. 

Essential Requirements
Applicants must have:
•	Medical degree recognised in Australia. 
•	Current registration (or eligibility for registration) with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA). 
•	Fellowship of RACGP, ACRRM or recognised overseas equivalent (or eligibility under relevant pathways). 
•	Excellent clinical, communication and interpersonal skills. 
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. 
•	Commitment to providing high-quality, patient-centred healthcare. 

What We Offer
•	IMGs requiring supervision: Guaranteed salary of $170,000–$250,000 + super, including comprehensive Level 1 supervision.
Fully Registered/VR GPs: Excellent earning potential with a competitive percentage of billings (up to 65%)  and an established patient base (plus superannuation where applicable).
•	Busy, established practice with a strong existing patient base. 
•	Accredited medical practice. 
•	Supportive team of experienced General Practitioners, nurses and allied health professionals. 
•	Bulk billing practice with excellent earning potential. 
•	On-site pathology services. 
•	Flexible working arrangements. 
•	Strong nursing support for immunisations, care plans, procedures and chronic disease management. 
•	Friendly, collaborative and non-corporate working environment. 
•	Convenient southern metropolitan Perth location. 

How to Apply
Applicants should submit:
•	Current CV 
•	Cover Letter 
•	Evidence of qualifications 
•	AHPRA registration details (or eligibility) 

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Global Vision Recruitment on behalf of Permalink Support Services

Date Posted: 13 July 2026

Position: Community Worker

Salary: $75,000 - $85,000 per annum plus 12% superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-time

Location: 12 Corporate Drive, Heatherton VIC 3202

Experience required: Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in community services, disability support, case management, or a similar role

Permalink Support Services is a trusted provider of disability and community support services, committed to empowering people with disability to live independently, participate actively in the community, and achieve their personal goals. We are seeking a compassionate and motivated Community Worker to join our team and deliver person-centred support while connecting clients with community services, programs, and resources that promote inclusion, wellbeing, and independence.

Key Responsibilities include but not limited to:

•	Assess clients' individual circumstances, conduct client interviews, identify support needs and personal goals, and develop, implement and review person-centred support plans. 

•	Assess clients' educational, training, employment, housing, health and social support needs, and facilitate access to appropriate services and programs that promote independence and social inclusion. 

•	Monitor clients' progress, evaluate support outcomes, prepare case notes and reports, and recommend adjustments to support plans where required. 

•	Refer clients to government agencies, community organisations, allied health professionals and other service providers that can provide additional assistance and specialised support. 

•	 Assess community needs, available resources and service gaps relating to health, welfare, housing, employment, education and training, and connect clients with appropriate community resources and external support providers. 

•	Liaise with families, carers, support coordinators, community groups, welfare agencies, government bodies, private businesses and other stakeholders to coordinate services, address community issues and promote awareness of available community resources. 

•	Facilitate community participation by encouraging clients' involvement in recreational, educational, vocational and social activities that enhance wellbeing, inclusion and quality of life. 

•	Provide practical guidance, advocacy and capacity-building support to assist clients, including young people, families and people with disability, to overcome social, emotional, behavioural, financial and everyday challenges while achieving their individual goals. 

•	Support families and carers by providing information, education and coordination of services to strengthen family wellbeing and community participation. 

•	Prepare reports, submissions and documentation required for funding, resources, service delivery and government or organisational reporting, while maintaining confidential client records in accordance with organisational policies, NDIS Practice Standards and relevant legislation. 

•	Identify opportunities for community development initiatives and collaborate with community stakeholders to improve access to services and promote collective solutions to community needs. 

•	Ensure all services are delivered in accordance with organisational policies, NDIS Practice Standards, relevant legislation and continuous quality improvement requirements.

Qualifications:

•	Relevant qualification in Community Services, Disability, Individual Support, Social Work, Welfare, or a related field.

•	Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in community services, disability support, case management, or a similar role.

Skills & Other Requirements:

•	Sound understanding of person-centred practice, community development principles, and client’s advocacy.

•	Knowledge of the NDIS, community support services, and relevant Australian legislation.

•	Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.

•	Strong organisational, case management, and problem-solving abilities.

•	Ability to prepare accurate documentation and maintain confidential client records.

•	Current NDIS Worker Screening Check, First Aid and CPR certification, Working with Children Check (where applicable), and a current Australian driver's licence.

If you are passionate about helping individuals build independence, access community opportunities, and improve their quality of life, we encourage you to apply for this rewarding opportunity with Permalink Support Services.

Interested applicants may submit their application to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
Performance Roles
Trading under Publicis Communications Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane


Performance Media Executive (also known as Performance Executive, Digital Activation Executive, Paid Search Executive, Senior Performance Executive, Senior Performance Media Executive)  
  
Role Overview   
The purpose of the Performance Media Executive is to assist in the implementation and management of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers. This role exists to support the Performance Media team across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation.  
   
Skills & Experience  
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.   
•	Supporting Account Managers and Directors across the team to deliver across account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copy-writing, quality-checks and best practice  
•	Own campaign execution in support to your Account Manager and Director, delivery and execution of a given customer campaign and/or account  
•	Assist in the development of insights for reporting, laddering up to the ‘so-what?’   
•	Own the building of new Search, Programmatic, Social campaign accounts ensuring a high level of detail is observed and we are aligned to the customer brief.  
•	Own the loading of monthly budgets and management of budget pacing through the month with Performance Media Coordinators.  
•	Own in the loading of proposed budgets into our invoicing system accurately and reconciling budgets on a monthly basis.   
•	Identify areas for account improvement and feed-back to Performance Media Managers and Directors and into Coordinators.  
•	Basic-Intermediate (12-24 months minimum) understanding and working knowledge of either SEM, Paid Social or Programmatic campaign build and/or management.  
•	Basic-Intermediate (6-24 months) understanding of Google or Adobe Analytics  
•	Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel   
•	Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Outlook)  
  
Salary: $85K - $90K package 


Performance Manager (Also known as Performance Media Manager, Associate Activation Manager, Digital Activation Manager, Paid Search Manager, Search Manager, Paid Social Manager, Social Manager, Programmatic Manager)

The purpose of the Performance Media Account Manager is to manage the delivery of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers/clients.
This role exists to deliver, with the support of the wider Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers.
Managing responsibilities of Executives and/or Coordinators to ensure account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copywriting, quality-checks and best practice. This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 3-4 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Excellent ability to analyse and manipulate data, extracting insights for reporting.
Salary: $85K - $110K package

Performance Director (Also known as Performance Media Director, Associate Activation Director, Digital Activation Director, Senior Search Manager, Search Director, Senior Paid Social Manager, Social Director, Programmatic Director)
The purpose of the Performance Director is to define industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers and also responsible for ensuring the best possible ROI for a client’s digital/performance media investment. This role exists to deliver, with the Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers/clients. Own the mid to senior customer relationship to ensure we are aligned with the customer and delivering on their business needs. Full responsibility for people management and account management/implementation within your team, and ensuring campaigns deliver against client KPIs. Responding to and presenting new business pitches.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Leadership and mentoring of performance digital teams 
Salary: $110K - $140K package

All roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
